pages.title: Cakefoot
pages.creator: dank.game
pages.description: Walk a cake along a narrow line in Cakefoot. Hold the button to go forward and release it to step backward, using both moves to avoid spikes, bombs, fire, and hungry fish. There are 22 levels between you and the end, and a live leaderboard tracks how your run compares.

pages.title: Fashion Makeover Dash
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Run through a mall in Fashion Makeover Dash and pick up clothes, accessories, and coins along the way. After the run, use what you collected to dress your character and try different combinations. You can also spend the coins to decorate the room where you put your looks together.

pages.title: Shape Shift
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Fly a spaceship through a field of geometric shapes in Shape Shift. Collect only the shapes and colors the game currently asks for, and steer around the others. Keep checking the target as you fly, because a shape that scores now may be one to avoid after it changes.

pages.title: Funny Doctor Emergency
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Treat patients in Funny Doctor Emergency, where each person comes in with a different problem. Look at the tools available, choose the one that fits the situation, and follow the treatment steps. Finish caring for one patient before moving on to see what the next person needs.

pages.title: Chain Puzzle
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Untangle linked pairs of colored balls in Chain Puzzle. Move the balls to loosen each crossing and watch the links between them change shape. A chain can shorten as you work, opening up a move that was blocked before. Find an order that frees all the chains from the knot.

pages.title: 3D Acrylic Nail: Nail Art Game
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Run a nail salon in 3D Acrylic Nail: Nail Art Game. Create acrylic designs with colors and accessories chosen to suit each customer’s request. Finishing a set earns money, which you can put toward salon upgrades before the next customer comes in with a different design in mind.

pages.title: DTA: Best Thief
pages.creator: GeekPlay
pages.description: Sneak through shops in DTA: Best Thief and take goods while keeping out of the administrators’ way. Complete quests as you work through the story and improve skills that help you move faster or stay hidden. The shops offer different goods and challenges, and there are pets to collect along the way.

pages.title: Physics Box 2
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Move a box by firing impulses in Physics Box 2. Time your clicks or taps to guide it past saws and laser gates, and reach buttons when a gate blocks the path. Across 45 levels, you’ll need to change how you apply the force to get through each layout.

pages.title: Merge Balls New Years Toys in 3D!
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Drop colored ornaments into a play area in Merge Balls New Years Toys in 3D! When matching balls touch, they combine into a larger ornament. Aim each drop so the new ball can meet its match, and build up bigger ornaments to earn points and climb the leaderboard.

pages.title: Sum Shuffle
pages.creator: MikeDavis
pages.description: Combine positive and negative numbers to reach a target in Sum Shuffle. Look at which numbers you can merge and how each choice changes the running total. There are 50 levels, starting with simpler combinations and working up to puzzles that take more planning to balance.

pages.title: Pull The Thread - Puzzle
pages.creator: KTV
pages.description: Stretch a thread around the screws in Pull The Thread - Puzzle. Look for a route that takes the thread past every screw to complete the pattern. As the layouts get more complicated, try a different order if the path you chose leaves a screw out of reach.

pages.title: Solitaires Crime Stories
pages.creator: Rainbow Games
pages.description: Play solitaire to follow a criminal investigation in Solitaires Crime Stories. Complete card puzzles to uncover what’s happening in Springdale, a small American town whose residents have secrets of their own. Each step of the investigation gives you another reason to clear the next board and see where the story goes.

pages.title: Craft Drill
pages.creator: Alex HK
pages.description: Guide a drill through a mine in Craft Drill. Break up rock to uncover valuable material, then send what you dig up along the conveyor to the truck. Sell the load and put the money back into your equipment so you can reach more of the deposit on the next run.

pages.title: Crazy Kick!
pages.creator: PhenomenalGames
pages.description: Curve a soccer shot around defenders and obstacles in Crazy Kick! Hold the left mouse button to aim and release to shoot. Look for a gap in front of the goal and time the strike so the ball can get through before an opponent moves into its path.

pages.title: Cotton Candy Games for Girls
pages.creator: kid kat
pages.description: Make cotton candy and potato chips in Cotton Candy Games for Girls. Pick from flavors and shapes such as hearts or stars, then decorate your cotton candy with fruit, chocolate, or ribbons. For chips, prepare the potatoes, fry the slices, and choose a seasoning to finish the snack.

pages.title: Super Friday Night vs Beast Guy
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Hit notes in time with the music in Super Friday Night vs Beast Guy. The second part of the series pits the real and fake Beast Guy against each other in rhythm battles. Follow the cues, press the corresponding buttons, and build your score as you work through the tracks.

pages.title: Diamond Match
pages.creator: GameEon Studios
pages.description: Make groups of at least three neighboring gems of the same color on the wheel in Diamond Match. Clear those groups for points and keep room for incoming stones. Unmatched gems can fill up the slots, so watch where each color goes as you try to preserve your lives.

pages.title: Memory Match
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Turn over cards and remember their pictures in Memory Match. Find the matching card and clear the pair, then use what you’ve already seen to make the next match. The timer keeps counting down as you search, so try to build your score before it runs out.

pages.title: Angry Guys
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Use a giant slingshot to fire characters at enemy defenses in Angry Guys. Aim for walls and barricades to knock them apart and reach the opponents behind them. Adjust where you send the next character based on what’s still standing after the last shot.

pages.title: Rail Maze Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Redirect trains through a maze in Rail Maze Puzzle. Check the color of each train and adjust the track so it follows the right route. A wrong turn can cause a crash, so watch the junctions as you work through more than 30 layouts.

pages.title: Siege Battleplan
pages.creator: Brave Giant LTD
pages.description: Capture enemy towers in Siege Battleplan by sending soldiers from your own positions. Click and drag to direct an attack, then watch for opposing troops moving toward your towers. Choose when to commit soldiers and when to hold them back so you can defend one position while taking another.

pages.title: Idle Hypermart Empire
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Run a retail operation in Idle Hypermart Empire. Put workers to work making goods, then use the elevator and cash office to transfer the proceeds into your account. Spend earnings on the warehouse, elevator, or store, and hire managers at each station to keep things running automatically.

pages.title: Crazy Bomber
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Fire shells at enemy groups in Crazy Bomber. Look over the compact battlefield to see where opponents are coming from, then aim to clear them before they get in your way. Unlock more powerful artillery as you progress and use it against the groups on later maps.

pages.title: Noob Hero Attitude
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Jump between buildings and cut ropes to rescue trapped characters in Noob Hero Attitude. Watch where the ropes are strung as you move between walls, and use the knife to free anyone in your path. Pick up coins and helpful objects during the climb to support the rescue.

pages.title: Get the Word!
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: You have six guesses to find a hidden word in Get the Word! Type a word to start, then use the colored feedback on its letters to choose the next guess. Each attempt gives you clues about which letters belong in the answer before you run out of chances.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Pro 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Shoot bubbles to clear the board in Bubble Shooter Pro 2. Aim at bubbles of the same color as your shot and join at least three to pop the group. Look for ways to clear more bubbles with a single shot and use boosters to help break up awkward sections.

pages.title: Stick Figure Badminton 2
pages.creator: Effing Games Inc.
pages.description: Pick one of eight characters in Stick Figure Badminton 2 and take them through a tournament. Each character has different stats, so try out a player that suits how you handle the rally. Return the shuttle over the net and look for a chance to send it past your opponent.

pages.title: Monster Wheels Apocalypse
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Drive an armed monster vehicle through hostile roads in Monster Wheels Apocalypse. Take on enemy vehicles, aircraft, and soldiers as you push ahead. Improve your weapons and build up the vehicle’s speed or shielding to prepare for the next stretch of road.

pages.title: Killer Zombies Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Reassemble six zombie pictures in Killer Zombies Jigsaw. Choose a 25-, 49-, or 100-piece puzzle for any image, then use the edges and details to work out where the pieces belong. Try a larger layout when you want to revisit a scene with more pieces to sort.

pages.title: Pop It Free Place
pages.creator: Flikes Games
pages.description: Fill complete lines to score in Pop It Free Place. The first bubble’s color is chosen for you, and the next bubbles must be beside the one you just popped, horizontally or vertically. Plan your route around the board to finish several lines together for more points.

pages.title: Interstellar Run
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Run through a space tunnel in Interstellar Run. Rotate around the tunnel to find solid ground, then jump when a gap cuts off your route. Keep clear of the lasers as you move from one section to the next and see how far you can go before the run ends.

pages.title: Enigmatic Blue Triangle
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide a blue triangle to the door in Enigmatic Blue Triangle. Move with WASD and watch for creatures and obstacles as you make your way through each level. Pick up the items you find along the route to build your score before heading for the exit.

pages.title: Ducklings.io
pages.creator: Pelican Party Studios
pages.description: Swim around the pond to rescue ducklings in Ducklings.io. Bring them back to your nest and watch out for boats on the way. Each upgrade makes the nest bigger and helps unlock hats. You can also share a room code with friends to rescue ducklings together.

pages.title: Among Arena
pages.creator: Jetti Games AB
pages.description: Collect wires to grow in Among Arena, a multiplayer game where size changes who can chase whom. Go after smaller players and steer clear of larger ones while you gather more wires. Choose a color and hat to customize your character before joining the arena again.

pages.title: Relic Guardians Arcade Ver. DX
pages.creator: Hermit Crab Game Studio
pages.description: Fight Space Chaos in Relic Guardians Arcade Ver. DX. Use turn-based choices inspired by rock, paper, scissors to defeat grunts and recover the seven relics of Earth-1. Work through the battles and get to the relics before Kaiser Dragon, the leader of the opposing side.

pages.title: Bullet League Robogeddon
pages.creator: Kiloo
pages.description: Survive a platform-shooter battle royale as a boar in Bullet League Robogeddon. Fight through an arena full of robots and stay alive until you’re the last combatant left. Watch for enemies above and below as you move between platforms and decide when to turn and fire.

pages.title: Cabana Beach Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Put together a picture of beach cabanas in Cabana Beach Jigsaw. Choose a puzzle mode, then drag the pieces into position to restore the scene. Look for where the lines of the buildings and the shapes in the background continue from one piece to the next.

pages.title: Heli Adventure
pages.creator: Extra Games
pages.description: Fly as far as you can in Heli Adventure. Click and release to control your helicopter’s height, keeping it away from the ground and other helicopters. Collect stars along the way for bonus points when you can reach them without putting the helicopter in the path of an obstacle.

pages.title: Water Cleaner
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Protect the sea from polluted rain in Water Cleaner. Fire the two cannons at dark drops before they hit the surface, and aim carefully because losing five shots also ends the game. Watch for the next dark drop while keeping track of the ammunition you have left.

pages.title: Car Wash Unlimited
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Clean and repair vehicles in Car Wash Unlimited. Pick what you want to work on, from a police car to a tractor or a bus, and take it through the wash and repair tasks. Switch vehicles when you want to see how the same job looks on a different ride.

pages.title: Easter 2020 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Choose one of six holiday pictures in Easter 2020 Puzzle and put it back together. Each image is available with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Start with a layout you can scan quickly, or pick a larger one and use small details to find where the pieces fit.

pages.title: Find Snow Balls
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Search each picture for hidden snowballs in Find Snow Balls. Move the pointer across the scene and check different parts of the background for the targets. Keep an eye on the clock while you finish each search and move on to the next layout.

pages.title: Car Parking 3D
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Follow the red arrow through a dockyard in Car Parking 3D. Guide your car to the designated spot and give yourself room to turn without hitting anything. Slow down as you get close so you can line up the final maneuver and park without a collision.

pages.title: Monster Truck Water Surfing: Truck Racing Games
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Take a monster truck out onto the water in Monster Truck Water Surfing: Truck Racing Games. Drive around the beach and head out across the surface to attempt stunts. Steer the truck as you move from dry ground onto the water and tackle the course from behind the wheel.

pages.title: Chop & Mine
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Put lumberjacks to work and dig for resources in Chop & Mine. Carve a route underground to reach crystals and ancient dinosaur bones, and steer away from dynamite and bombs along the way. The mine keeps generating more ground to explore while your workers collect wood above.

pages.title: Chicken Love
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Guide a chicken on a rescue journey in Chicken Love. Travel through dangerous areas where trolls stand between the chicken and the one it’s trying to save. Watch the route as you go and find a way past the trolls to reach the end of the journey.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Earth Day
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Join Baby Hazel for Earth Day and help her learn ways to look after the environment. Follow her as she learns about caring for plants and saving electricity, then head to the nearby park for the Earth Day event. Help her take part in the activities as the day unfolds.

pages.title: African Princess Jigsaw
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Rebuild one of 12 princess illustrations in African Princess Jigsaw. Choose 25, 49, or 100 pieces to set the difficulty, then look for the edges and nearby colors to find where each piece fits. Try another picture or replay the same one with a more detailed cut.

pages.title: Adam and Eve 6
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help Adam find his true love in Adam and Eve 6. Click or tap objects in each scene to see what they do, then work out what has to happen before Adam can carry on. Look around whenever the way is blocked, because the solution can be part of the scenery.

pages.title: 1010 Diamonds Rush
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Collect diamonds by clearing the rows or columns that contain them in 1010 Diamonds Rush. Pick a block shape from the side panel and place it in the grid to fill gaps. Look ahead before you drop a piece so there’s space left for another shape where you need it.

pages.title: 3D SNAKE
pages.creator: Joakim Nyland
pages.description: Guide a snake around a 3D play area in 3D SNAKE. Use the arrows on the screen to steer toward apples while avoiding crashes. The menu lets you switch to a first-person view, and collecting enough apples gives you something to spend in the snake shop.

pages.title: 49 Puzzle
pages.creator: mrseo88
pages.description: Start anywhere on the board in 49 Puzzle, then place each number in sequence until you reach 49. Where you can put the next number depends on how far it is from the previous one. Think ahead before choosing a square so you have somewhere to go on the following turn.

pages.title: Desktop Racing 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Race toy cars across a cluttered office desk in Desktop Racing 2. Pick up coins along the track and pull off stunts to earn boosts. Spend what you collect on upgrades for your current car or buy a different one to take through the tabletop courses.

pages.title: TankHit
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Duel another tank in the 3D mazes and arenas of TankHit. Play against the computer or a friend, and make each shot count when your magazine holds five rounds. Pick up power-ups to give yourself an edge and try to land five hits before the other tank does.

pages.title: City Car Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive different cars through a city in City Car Simulator. Choose from three driving modes, then use WASD to accelerate, brake, and steer. Press Space for the handbrake when you need it, or switch the camera with C for a different view of the car and street.

pages.title: Math Test Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Answer math questions against the clock in Math Test Challenge. You get five seconds for each question, so read the problem and choose your answer before time runs out. Keep solving as the next problems come up and see whether you can beat your previous score.

pages.title: Idle Farm
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Grow crops and raise animals to earn money in Idle Farm. Hire helpers, put the profits toward new plots, and expand what you can grow or sell as you level up. You can also play a pinball minigame for extra coins and progress when you want a break from farming.

pages.title: Beehive Blitz
pages.creator: Fizzy Cool
pages.description: Stack cards of the same rank in Beehive Blitz, a speed-focused version of Beehive Solitaire. Work through the layout until you’ve cleared all 13 sets. Try the keyboard controls if you want to improve your fastest time, or use the mouse or touch controls to play at your own pace.

pages.title: Dont Touch the Pixel
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Guide a pixel along a narrow passage in Dont Touch the Pixel. Keep it away from the edges and watch the turns so you can adjust before the path closes in. The farther you get, the more you can push your score on the next attempt.

pages.title: 2048 Classic Edition
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Slide the number tiles around the grid in 2048 Classic Edition. When two tiles with the same value meet, they combine into a tile worth their sum. Make room for future moves as you build higher values and work toward a tile marked 2048.

pages.title: Bubble Pop Adventures
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Help a mother mushroom rescue her trapped babies in Bubble Pop Adventures. Match colored bubbles to open a path and use special bubbles when a shot needs extra reach. The game has 24 levels, and setting up combo clears can add points as you free the little mushrooms.

pages.title: Masked Forces Unlimited
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take on enemies in Masked Forces Unlimited, a first-person shooter with solo and multiplayer modes. Play across nine maps and choose from three game modes. Visit the shop for weapons and armor, and try modifiers such as double speed or double jump to change how a match plays.

pages.title: Halloween Princess Makeover
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Get Anna ready for Halloween in Halloween Princess Makeover. Start by taking care of her skin, then use the makeover options to put together a look for the celebration. Take the princess through the preparations so she’s ready to enjoy her favorite holiday.

pages.title: Little Mermaid Mystery
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Swim through an underwater obstacle course in Little Mermaid Mystery. Hold the mouse button or Up arrow to rise, and release to sink. Collect pearls and score points as you move through the scene, while dodging hazards that take away hearts when you touch them.

pages.title: Conquer
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Claim as much of the board as you can in Conquer. Watch the trails opponents leave as they move and cross one when you have a chance to knock that player out. Protect your own trail while expanding, and pick up speed boosts to help you get away or catch a rival.

pages.title: Hidden Gold Stars
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Search spring scenes for hidden stars in Hidden Gold Stars. Scan each picture for small shapes that blend into the background and find the full set before time runs out. There are five timed levels, each with another scene to look through for the stars.

pages.title: Dark Warrior Creator
pages.creator: Missangest Games
pages.description: Design a dark warrior in Dark Warrior Creator. Choose armor for your character and give her a weapon that suits the design. Try different combinations of gear to see how they change her look, then finish with the outfit you want her to take into battle.

pages.title: Waking Up Sleeping Beauty
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Wake Princess Aurora in Waking Up Sleeping Beauty so she can get ready for her date. Try the pranks prepared for the sleepy princess and see which ones get a reaction. Help her start the day before she’s supposed to meet her prince.

pages.title: Wind Soldier
pages.creator: Kuro obi games
pages.description: Steer a parachuting soldier into a warzone in Wind Soldier. Guide him through the dangers on the way down and pick up shields to protect him. Keep watching what’s ahead as you descend and work toward completing the mission with the soldier still in one piece.

pages.title: Algebraic Fish Frenzy
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Work out the value of x in Algebraic Fish Frenzy, then tap the fish carrying that number. Read the equation at the top before scanning the fish for your answer. Each new problem gives you another chance to connect the value you calculate with the right target.

pages.title: Bullethell adventure 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Blast through waves of enemies across several islands in Bullethell adventure 2. Move around enemy attacks as you fight your way toward the rescue. Collect coins along the route and spend them on weapons or abilities to help you handle the next wave.

pages.title: Bubble Burst
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Aim at groups of matching colors in Bubble Burst and pop your way through space. Look for a shot that connects with the bubbles you want to clear and build up the burst meter as you go. Check the layout again after each shot for the next opening.

pages.title: I want to be a billionaire
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Start a business and work toward a billion in I want to be a billionaire. Choose where to spend your cash, then collect what each business earns and put some of it back into upgrades. Compare costs with what a business can bring in before opening another one.

pages.title: Bomb It 2
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Place bombs to blast through obstacles and take out opponents in Bomb It 2. Leave yourself a clear route away from the blast before you set a bomb, and watch for the ones your rivals drop. Try different arenas and game modes to change how each round plays.

pages.title: Elsa Makeover
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Prepare Elsa for a party in Elsa Makeover. Start with makeup, then choose a hairstyle and see how it looks with different dresses. Finish by picking shoes and accessories that suit the outfit you’ve put together for the celebration.
